claim: The criteria yield 7 superteams: 2017 GSW, 2011 MIA, 2005 SAS, 1999 SAS, 1987 MIL, 1987 DET and 1983 PHI.
code:
(pd.read_csv("data/web.csv")
 .assign(tm=lambda d: np.where(d.team_change, d.tm.str.split(",").str[-1], d.tm.str.split(",").str[0]))
 .pipe(lambda d: d[["bbrID","season_year","age","team_change","tm"]]
        .merge(d.loc[d.rank_ws48 < 15, ["bbrID","season_year"]], on="bbrID", suffixes=("","_q"))
        .query("season_year_q >= season_year - 3 and season_year_q <= season_year - 1 and age < 34")
        .drop_duplicates(["bbrID","season_year"])
        .merge(d.loc[d.rank_ws48 < 5, ["bbrID","season_year"]].assign(season_year=lambda x: x.season_year + 1, sup=True), on=["bbrID","season_year"], how="left")
        .assign(sup=lambda x: x.sup.fillna(False))
        .groupby(["season_year","tm"])
        .agg(n=("bbrID","nunique"), acquired=("team_change","any"), superstar=("sup","any"))
        .query("n >= 3 and acquired and superstar")
        .reset_index()
        .assign(year=lambda x: x.season_year + 1, total=lambda x: len(x))
        .set_index(["year","tm"])[["n","total"]]
        .sort_index(ascending=False)))
